alt: Ovaries, uterine tubes and uterus seen from behind with the wall cut away (OpenStax) - infundibulum, fimbriae, ampulla and isthmus of the uterine tube; fundus, body, isthmus and cervix of the uterus; endometrium, myometrium and perimetrium; broad, ovarian and suspensory ligaments; ovarian, uterine and vaginal vessels. Insets show ovarian cortex histology.
